parts.title: Part 5

questions.text: Why did John decide to enter the race?

options.text: He was encouraged by his father to take part.
He wanted to prove his friends wrong.
He was inspired by a celebrity's achievements.

questions.text: One feature of John's training before the event was to…

options.text: get some rest between training sessions.
leave himself enough time to build up his fitness.
set targets that he felt were realistic.

questions.text: What made Laura decide to go on the beach trip with her uncle?

options.text: She recently visited an exhibition about the area.
She became interested in archaeology through internet research.
She realised it was the best way to prepare for some schoolwork.

questions.text: When Laura's uncle showed her some real dinosaur bones, she…

options.text: found it hard to imagine how big the creature had been.
was disappointed to hear they hadn't been discovered locally.
began to hope they'd find something similar during their beach trip.

questions.text: Tom started playing the electric guitar because…

options.text: he was encouraged to do so by his parents.
he found certain pieces of guitar music appealing.
he failed to make progress on other instruments.

questions.text: What did Tom love about his new electric guitar?

options.text: It filled him with confidence when he performed in public.
It helped him make friends because he could play so well.
It made him look like a rock star in his photos.
